chunks: 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The woman in nifas remains seated [i.e., refrains from acts requiring ritual purity], if the blood does not stop from her, for thirty or forty days, up to fifty.

key_terms.النُّفَسَاءُ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding

ai.seo_question: How long can nifas continue according to a hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the maximum duration of nifas when postnatal bleeding continues. It indicates that the woman in nifas may remain in that state for thirty or forty days, extending up to fifty days.
